name: Drum & Bass
blurb: Liquid jungle at 174: a chopped breakbeat sprints while a rolling reese sub and lush Rhodes 9ths just float underneath.

flavors.label: Liquid Roller
flavors.blurb: Rhodes 9ths washing over a rolling break — the pretty end of 174.

flavors.label: Techstep Drone
flavors.blurb: One minor chord for the whole tune, stabbed short so the reese owns everything else.

flavors.label: Jungle Stab
flavors.blurb: Chopped-amen ragga: clipped dorian organ stabs, pushed and a little ahead of the grid.

flavors.label: Jump-Up Bounce
flavors.blurb: Two chords, hard on the one, all the room left for a cartoon bassline.

flavors.label: Half-Time Soul
flavors.blurb: 174 that feels like 87 — long maj7 pads breathing across two bars each.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Drum and bass harmony sits nearly still while the drums sprint. Liquid leans jazz-soul: minor 9ths, maj7 pads, dorian i-IV shuttles and bVI-bVII-i lifts, two bars a chord. Jungle and techstep collapse to a single minor drone under a reese. Rarely bright, never fast-moving — the sub picks the root, the pad just glows above it.
